name: Session Handoff Skill
purpose: Starts and ends long work sessions honestly across Windows and the Mac render host: find the newest handoff, check the tree matches it, probe the host and lock, keep the four prompts/state files, queue Mac-only work, prepare owner decision packs, and recover from a reverted working tree.
capabilities: Start checklist with stop conditions (stale tree, held lock, missing tools)
Stop checklist for log.md, render-queue.md, decisions-needed.md, host-windows.md, tracker and dated handoff
Revert recovery procedure from vendored copies and Copilot session logs

compatibility.notes: Windows-first; the start and stop checks are host-neutral.

security.notes: Reads local session logs only for recovery; never sends them anywhere.

approval_evidence: Encodes the 2026-11-19..25 Windows handoffs and the 2026-11-25 revert recovery (36 files rebuilt and verified against recorded checker output).
